notes.title: Ragnarok Survivors Valhalla - Update v1.0.1 🛡️⚔️
notes.notes:
Hail, warriors of Valhalla! 🛡️⚔️

Your cries have been heard, and Odin himself has whispered the secrets of balance into our ears. Here's what we've forged for you in this divine update:

💰 Gold and 💎 Crystal Rebalancing:

Loki's meddling with the economy has been tamed. Gold and crystals now flow as the gods intended—no more hoarding like a dragon or scraping by like a mortal. Fair treasure for all!

🔮 Rune Special Weapons Tweaks ✨

Thor swung his hammer and smacked some sense into the drop rates. Your favorite godly tools of destruction are now more balanced.

💀 Offscreen Death Bug Vanquished:

Hel's realm was getting overrun with unearned souls—those sneaky enemies dying offscreen. We've fixed this! Now every death will be witnessed and savored. Glory in your victories, hero.


Grab your gear, brave warrior, and return to battle! Ragnarok won’t survive itself. As always, keep the feedback coming and may your saga grow ever legendary. 🌟

- The Ragnarok Survivors Valhalla Dev Team

Skål! 🍻🪓🧔‍♂️💀
